issues.detail: The skill does not cover all possible error scenarios, such as missing configuration or network failures.

scenarios.name: initialize-openspec-multi-tools
scenarios.rationale: Response B includes the required init command, explains the creation of the openspec/ folder and its contents, and confirms setup, while Response A omits the init command and folder structure.

scenarios.name: propose-and-validate-change
scenarios.rationale: Response A follows the exact openspec workflow and includes validation, while Response B only provides a design document and omits all required openspec commands.

scenarios.name: archive-approved-change
scenarios.rationale: Response A includes the required command and notes the merge and archive steps, while Response B uses unrelated git commands.
